canDoYue: 你識講星期一、二、四、五請假，星期三係公眾假期，Jo 頂位，星期五寫交接，批核只得一次。
canDoEn: Ask for Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday off, name Jo as cover, send one handover, and hear one approval after that Friday note.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I would like annual leave next week on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday, but not on Wednesday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想下星期請年假，星期一、二、四、五，星期三唔請。
dialogue.say: I would like annual leave next week on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday, but not on Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Wednesday is a public holiday next week, so your leave days are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 下星期三係公眾假期，所以你嘅年假係星期一、二、四、五。
dialogue.say: Wednesday is a public holiday next week, so your leave days are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Jo will cover my desk next week, and I can send the handover by email that morning.
dialogue.glossYue: Jo 下星期會頂我個位，我可以嗰朝用電郵交交接。
dialogue.say: Jo will cover my desk next week, and I can send the handover by email that morning.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Please email me the handover before you go, and I will read it fully before I decide.
dialogue.glossYue: 你走之前用電郵交畀我，我會睇完先決定。
dialogue.say: Please email me the handover before you go, and I will read it fully before I decide.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I will write that handover note this Friday morning, just before my first leave day on Monday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會呢個星期五朝早寫交接筆記，就喺星期一放假之前。
dialogue.say: I will write that handover note this Friday morning, just before my first leave day on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Please send it to me before you go, and I will read every line before I decide.
dialogue.glossYue: 你走之前傳畀我，我會逐行睇完先決定。
dialogue.say: Please send it to me before you go, and I will read every line before I decide.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Thank you. Jo will cover the desk, and I will be back right after those four dates.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。Jo 會頂住個位，我放完嗰四日就返。
dialogue.say: Thank you. Jo will cover the desk, and I will be back right after those four dates.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: I will approve it after I read that Friday handover note, and leave starts on Monday next.
dialogue.glossYue: 我睇完星期五嗰份交接筆記就會批，年假下星期一開始。
dialogue.say: I will approve it after I read that Friday handover note, and leave starts on Monday next.
